services.name: Tandem HALO
services.desc: Our instructors have thousands of jumps, but our gear doesn’t! We’ve invested over $50,000 this year alone on new tandem equipment for your safety and comfort! New equipment is proven to be more reliable, open softer, and land smoother. Unlike some operators, who often jump gear until it wears out, we prefer to replace our equipment on a regular basis and sell the used stuff to them. We only jump the Sigma Tandem Parachute system, the best system in the world. We meticulously maintain our equipment at our onsite Parachute Rigging Loft, Action Air Parachutes. Our riggers are certified by the Federal Aviation Authority and work extensively with both civilian and military parachute systems.

services.name: HALO Skydive
services.desc: Tandem Skydiving is the most common and safest method of training for first time jumpers and has made the sport accessible to millions of people worldwide. During your Tandem Skydive, you will be paired with one of our highly skilled USPA rated Instructors who will be with you every step of the way. Whether your goal is to become a United States Parachute Association (USPA) certified skydiver or you just want to give it a try, SkyDance SkyDiving is the best place to begin. Highly-trained, independently operating USPA rated tandem instructors will give you specialized instruction before your first skydive. This training takes approximately 20 minutes and will cover everything you will need

includes: Training Class, Certificate & Logbook entry, Bumper Sticker with tandem jumps
Specialized HALO equipment including O2, mask, helmet, goggles, altimeter, and balaclava
gap: Age minimum not stated for tandem or training
blurb: Guests can do tandem skydives from various altitudes, experienced skydiving jumps, and HALO jumps. Training programs include Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) courses to become licensed solo skydivers. The dropzone provides gear rental, rigging loft, and a friendly community environment.
